title: ☕ The Secret Ingredient in the Old Cafe (Learn English) #Shorts

subtitles.en: Sunlight shines into the old cafe.
subtitles.zh: 陽光灑進了這間老咖啡館。

subtitles.en: Alex inherited this shop from his grandfather.
subtitles.zh: Alex 從他祖父那裡繼承了這家店。

subtitles.en: Today, he and Mia clean and organize the place together.
subtitles.zh: 今天，他和 Mia 一起清理並整理這家店。

subtitles.en: Under the wooden counter, Mia finds a very old notebook.
subtitles.zh: 在木製櫃檯下，Mia 發現了一本很舊的筆記本。

subtitles.en: It is a recipe book.
subtitles.zh: 那是一本食譜。

subtitles.en: Inside, there is a coffee called "Starry Night Latte."
subtitles.zh: 裡面寫著一種叫做「星夜拿鐵」的咖啡。

subtitles.en: But, the last page is missing.
subtitles.zh: 但是，最後一頁不見了。

subtitles.en: It is missing the most important ingredient.
subtitles.zh: 它缺少了最重要的成分。

subtitles.en: Every afternoon, an old lady comes to the cafe to drink coffee.
subtitles.zh: 每天下午，都有一位老太太來咖啡館喝咖啡。

subtitles.en: But when she takes a sip of the latte, she always shakes her head.
subtitles.zh: 但當她啜飲拿鐵時，總是會搖搖頭。

subtitles.en: She looks out the window.
subtitles.zh: 她望向窗外。

subtitles.en: She feels this is not the taste in her memory.
subtitles.zh: 她覺得這不是她記憶中的味道。

subtitles.en: To help the old lady, Mia and Alex look at the old notebook carefully.
subtitles.zh: 為了幫助這位老太太，Mia 和 Alex 仔細查看了那本舊筆記本。

subtitles.en: They find an old photo inside.
subtitles.zh: 他們在裡面發現了一張舊照片。

subtitles.en: On the back, it says, "Cinnamon from my hometown."
subtitles.zh: 背面寫著：「來自家鄉的肉桂」。

subtitles.en: This is the missing secret ingredient!
subtitles.zh: 這就是那缺失的秘密配方！

subtitles.en: With this new discovery, they walk into the kitchen immediately.
subtitles.zh: 有了這個新發現，他們立刻走進廚房。

subtitles.en: Alex makes the coffee carefully.
subtitles.zh: Alex 仔細地沖泡咖啡。

subtitles.en: Mia adds the special cinnamon powder.
subtitles.zh: Mia 加入了特製的肉桂粉。

subtitles.en: The air is full of a good smell.
subtitles.zh: 空氣中充滿了迷人的香氣。

subtitles.en: They bring this cup of coffee to the old lady with hope.
subtitles.zh: 他們懷著希望將這杯咖啡端給老太太。

subtitles.en: The old lady takes a sip.
subtitles.zh: 老太太啜飲了一口。

subtitles.en: She smiles happily, but she also sheds a tear.
subtitles.zh: 她開心地笑了，但眼角也泛起了淚光。

subtitles.en: She looks at the empty seat across from her.
subtitles.zh: 她看向對面空著的座位。

subtitles.en: She thinks of her late husband.
subtitles.zh: 她想起了她已故的丈夫。

subtitles.en: This cup of coffee brings new warmth to this old shop.
subtitles.zh: 這杯咖啡為這家老店帶來了新的溫暖。
